description.html: The artificial plant with feathery leaves is a dense, bright green plant with fine, needle-like leaves. It stands upright on a light-colored base and gives the impression of lush, healthy greenery.

Unlike live plants, an artificial one needs no lighting, fertilizer or trimming and does not change water quality. Even fish that usually destroy plants cannot eat it, and the dense leaves give cover to smaller fish and fry.

The dense, fine leaves are a favorite hiding place for fry and small fish. The plant looks good in groups or as a backdrop behind lower decorations, and its green color stands out especially well on a dark substrate. Maintenance is simple: every few weeks, or when you notice algae, rinse the plant with lukewarm water and go over it with a soft brush. Do not use detergents or cleaning products.
